projects.title: Revenue Tracking Dashboard
projects.summary: Interactive Power BI dashboard for profitability analysis and real-time KPI monitoring across product lines.
projects.problem: Decision-makers lacked a unified view of revenue performance across product categories, making it difficult to identify underperforming segments.
projects.approach: Built a multi-page Power BI report using DAX measures for dynamic KPIs, a star-schema data model connecting sales, product, and date tables, and interactive slicers enabling drill-down by region, product, and time period.
projects.learning: Designing for non-technical stakeholders means prioritising clarity over complexity — one well-placed KPI card communicates more than a dense table of numbers.

projects.title: Hotel Booking Analytics
projects.summary: Hospitality dashboard visualising booking trends, occupancy rates, and revenue — driving pricing optimisation decisions.
projects.problem: A hotel business had raw booking data but no visibility into trends — management couldn't identify seasonal patterns, peak periods, or underperforming room categories.
projects.approach: Connected booking data to Power BI, built time-intelligence DAX measures for month-over-month comparisons, and created an occupancy heatmap alongside a revenue waterfall chart.
projects.learning: Time intelligence in DAX is deceptively powerful. DATESINPERIOD and SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR unlock patterns that raw data completely hides.

projects.title: Stock Performance Analysis
projects.summary: Amazon & Facebook vs. S&P 500 using Sharpe ratio, beta, and standard deviation for actionable investment insights.
projects.problem: Raw return figures alone don't tell the full story. The goal was to evaluate whether higher returns from tech stocks were justified given the additional risk.
projects.approach: Used Python (Pandas, Matplotlib, NumPy) to pull and clean historical price data, then computed Sharpe ratios, beta coefficients, and annualised standard deviation.
projects.learning: Beta reveals how much market risk you're actually carrying. Higher return doesn't always mean better investment.

projects.title: Business Metrics Analysis
projects.summary: SQL analysis answering key questions on customer behaviour, product performance, and revenue drivers.
projects.problem: The business had transactional data across multiple tables but no structured analysis to answer basic performance questions.
projects.approach: Wrote complex SQL queries using JOINs, CTEs, window functions (RANK, ROW_NUMBER, LAG), and aggregate functions to answer each business question.
projects.learning: Window functions transform SQL from a retrieval tool into a genuine analytical engine.

projects.title: Farm Encroachment Detection
projects.summary: Spatial analysis identifying 76 farms inside Ghana's protected forest reserves — informing certification decisions.
projects.problem: Sustainability certification requires all certified farms to operate within legal land boundaries. Manual verification was infeasible at scale.
projects.approach: Loaded GPS coordinates as point layers in QGIS and overlaid them against official forest reserve boundary shapefiles. Ran spatial intersection queries to flag farms inside protected zones.
projects.learning: Always verify CRS alignment before any spatial join — mismatched projections produce confident but wrong results.

projects.title: Child Labour Risk Dashboard
projects.summary: Risk indicator dashboard enabling interventions that helped 56 children leave hazardous work and return to school.
projects.problem: Programme officers needed a clear picture of which communities had the highest concentrations of at-risk children.
projects.approach: Designed KoboCollect survey forms, built an Excel-based cleaning pipeline, then created a dashboard with colour-coded risk maps reviewed weekly with programme management.
projects.learning: Data quality depends entirely on the field form design. Design for the analyst, not just the enumerator.

projects.title: Farmer Delivery Tracking System
projects.summary: Automated tools for 26 cocoa cooperatives tracking deliveries vs. expected volumes — cutting reporting time by 30%.
projects.problem: Union managers were manually reconciling delivery records from multiple sources, creating delays and errors in bonus disbursement.
projects.approach: Built structured Excel templates with dropdown validation, automated row formatting, and pivot-based summary sheets with data integrity checks.
projects.learning: A well-designed Excel template eliminates hours of manual work for teams with no coding background.

projects.title: Productivity Department Dashboard
projects.summary: Multi-page dashboard tracking field activities and farm performance across 26 farming communities.
projects.problem: The Productivity team tracked activities through disconnected spreadsheets, making it impossible to get a quick overview of programme reach.
projects.approach: Consolidated data from multiple field sources into a Power BI model with pages for field officer activity, farm performance, trend analysis, and target vs. actual comparisons.
projects.learning: Timeliness beats perfection. A weekly-refreshed dashboard at 90% is infinitely more valuable than a perfect monthly report.

blog.title: 5 Power BI DAX Formulas Every Analyst Should Know
blog.preview: From CALCULATE to RANKX — the DAX functions that unlock your dashboards.
blog.content:
## Why DAX Matters
Power BI is only as powerful as the formulas driving it.

## 1. CALCULATE
Modifies the filter context — foundation of every complex measure.

## 2. RANKX
Dynamic rankings that update as users filter.

## 3. DIVIDE
Safe division that handles zero denominators gracefully.

## 4. DATESINPERIOD
Rolling time calculations without hardcoding dates.

## 5. SWITCH(TRUE())
Replaces messy nested IF statements elegantly.

blog.preview: How Excel and KoboCollect became tools for social impact in cocoa communities.
blog.content:
## The Problem
Child labour in Ghana's cocoa farming communities is a persistent challenge.

## The Data Solution
Dashboard visualising child labour risk indicators across farming societies.

## The Outcome
56 children returned to school after targeted data-driven interventions.

## What This Taught Me
